picks.title: MCP servers for Figma, Jira, GitLab and Playwright
picks.excerpt: A practical setup guide for wiring Figma, Jira, GitLab and Playwright MCP servers into a coding agent, covering the different auth models and what each server actually exposes. Positions the Figma MCP server as the design-context bridge in an agent toolchain.
picks.rationale: The most directly actionable item in the pool: a step-by-step wiring of the Figma MCP server into a real agent toolchain, with the auth models spelled out.

picks.title: Deploy Cursor Origin repositories with Vercel, in public beta
picks.excerpt: Pro and Enterprise teams can connect Cursor Origin repositories to Vercel so agent-authored pull requests automatically get Preview Deployments and production deploys on merge. Closes the loop between an IDE agent and a reviewable, shareable UI build.
picks.rationale: Agent-written PRs now land as Preview Deployments automatically, so designers get a clickable URL to review instead of a diff.

picks.title: Dark mode toggles: two states are enough
picks.excerpt: Lea Verou pushes back on three-state light/dark/system toggles, arguing two states plus a correct default covers every real color-scheme scenario. A concrete token-and-theming decision that design systems keep getting wrong.
picks.rationale: A single theming decision most design systems get wrong, argued case by case by Lea Verou — changeable in a design system tomorrow.

picks.title: Opinion: AI has passed the mechanical Turing test
picks.excerpt: Leo AI CEO Maor Farid argues mechanical engineering has crossed a 'mechanical Turing test' threshold — AI-generated designs are now indistinguishable from human-made manufacturable parts, citing a 791% rise in positive user responses by July.
picks.rationale: A dated threshold claim with usage numbers behind it, from the CEO of the leading text-to-CAD tool — the clearest read yet on where generative CAD output actually stands.

picks.title: Turn one image into a full set of on-brand assets with Adobe Stock AI Studio
picks.excerpt: Adobe walks through turning a single source image into a full set of on-brand assets using Adobe Stock's AI Studio. A concrete brand-consistency workflow for teams generating campaign variants from one hero image.
picks.rationale: Adobe demonstrating its own brand-consistency workflow end to end — the campaign-variant problem every design team hits, answered with one hero image.
